summary: @onereach/step-conversation preinstall executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares preinstall: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is variable-name obfuscated (`_0xNNNN` identifiers with object-map string indirection). At `npm install` it checks whether `bun` is on PATH and, if not, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` on the installer's host with the installer's privileges. math_init.js is a ~712 KB single-line obfuscated bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hundreds-of-entry string table, `WV8StW` array-rotation decoder, hex-numbered identifiers) whose filename and content have no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (Onereach.ai conversation step classes); the declared `main` (`dst/index.js`) is a small conversation library that never imports math_init.js. The runtime swap to Bun bypasses Node-based install-time inspection, and the obfuscated payload is executed unconditionally on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
